test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: By driving the car at an average speed of 40 km per hour, I reach my destination in 7 hours. With what speed I can reach the same destination in 5 hours?
solution:
**Given:**

Average speed = 40 km/h

Time taken = 7 hours

**Concept used:**

Distance = Time × speed

**Calculation:**

Total distance = 40 × 7 = 280 km

Required average speed = 280 ÷ 5 = 56 km/h

**∴ I can reach the same destination in 5 hours at 56 km per hour.**
